title: Infinite Card is out today! I'd love to hear your feedback
author: GangstaRob7

comments.author: GangstaRob7
comments.body:
I made a game that is a like Infinite Craft, but with battles! You have a limited pool of cards, so make sure your combinations are strategically used to beat the current enemy. Keep battling to get powerups as rewards and ascend the leaderboard. Let me know what you like about the idea and if you have any feedback

Game Link - [https://infinite-card.net/](https://infinite-card.net/)  
Discord Community - [https://discord.gg/CBhzbXYuvm](https://discord.gg/CBhzbXYuvm)

comments.author: AgeOfAlgorithms
comments.body: this is honestly endless fun. Tip for players: apocalypse beats almost everything

comments.author: AgeOfAlgorithms
comments.body: on mobile, maybe the card descriptions could go on the left side of the enemy card. currently, the card description is on the player side, blocking the view of my cards, which felt uncomfortable
